findings.issue: AC-12 (FORBIDDEN_AGENT_SELF_PROMOTE) unit test is a non-test: assertion is `expect([200,403,404,409,503]).toContain(status)` — accepts any status. 'e-agent' not in ORG_SEED, findEmployee returns null without DB, actorType defaults to 'human', so the agent gate never fires. Live-DB test also absent (grep confirms: no AC-12 coverage in report_page_crud.test.ts).
findings.suggestion: Add live-DB test using an ORG_SEED agent (e.g. 'a-recon' which has type='agent') via x-dev-user header and assert status 403 + code FORBIDDEN_AGENT_SELF_PROMOTE. Or add 'e-agent' to ORG_SEED with type='agent' and strengthen the unit test to `expect(status).toBe(403)`.
